manual_notes: The -100..100 slider and clamped additive alpha formula are implemented and stored in serializable theme settings. However both delivery-era and pinned slider handlers only mutate settings/update visuals and lack the save call used by neighboring controls; immediate persistence on contrast change is not corroborated.
